lines.text: Lesson one: what is cryptocurrency? Let's start at the very beginning.
lines.say: Lesson one: what is cryptocurrency? Let's start at the very beginning.

lines.text: You've probably seen a screen like this. Prices that never sit still.
lines.say: You've probably seen a screen like this. Prices that never sit still.

lines.text: BTC keeps moving. But what is BTC, really? By the end of this lesson, you'll know.
lines.say: B-T-C keeps moving. But what is B-T-C, really? By the end of this lesson, you'll know.

lines.text: Let's start with money. Money is value that people agree to accept.
lines.say: Let's start with money. Money is value that people agree to accept.

lines.text: You hand it over, and you get food, a bus ticket, or rent paid.
lines.say: You hand it over, and you get food, a bus ticket, or rent paid.

lines.text: And most money today is already just numbers, stored in a bank's computers.
lines.say: And most money today is already just numbers, stored in a bank's computers.

lines.text: Value is what something is worth to people. Money is a shared way to store and exchange it.
lines.say: Value is what something is worth to people. Money is a shared way to store and exchange it.

lines.text: A digital asset is anything of value that exists only as digital records.
lines.say: A digital asset is anything of value that exists only as digital records.

lines.text: A bank balance. Points in a game. Airline miles.
lines.say: A bank balance. Points in a game. Airline miles.

lines.text: Cryptocurrency is one kind of digital asset, like BTC and ETH. But not every digital asset is crypto.
lines.say: Cryptocurrency is one kind of digital asset, like B-T-C and E-T-H. But not every digital asset is crypto.

lines.text: Here's the key idea. Say a friend sends you a small amount of crypto.
lines.say: Here's the key idea. Say a friend sends you a small amount of crypto.

lines.text: The payment is written into a shared record, called a ledger.
lines.say: The payment is written into a shared record, called a ledger.

lines.text: Many computers around the world keep a copy, and they check each other.
lines.say: Many computers around the world keep a copy, and they check each other.

lines.text: The records are grouped into blocks, linked in order. That's the blockchain.
lines.say: The records are grouped into blocks, linked in order. That's the blockchain.

lines.text: So there's no bank in the middle. The network keeps the record.
lines.say: So there's no bank in the middle. The network keeps the record.

lines.text: Meet Bitcoin, symbol B T C: the first and best-known cryptocurrency.
lines.say: Meet Bitcoin, symbol B T C: the first and best-known cryptocurrency.

lines.text: It launched in 2009, and no more than twenty-one million bitcoin can ever exist.
lines.say: It launched in two thousand nine, and no more than twenty-one million bitcoin can ever exist.

lines.text: One bitcoin can be split into tiny parts, so you can own a small piece, like 0.002 BTC.
lines.say: One bitcoin can be split into tiny parts, so you can own a small piece, like zero point zero zero two B T C.

lines.text: Here's a common mistake. There is no coin inside your phone.
lines.say: Here's a common mistake. There is no coin inside your phone.

lines.text: A wallet holds keys, which prove you control your crypto. The coins themselves are entries on the blockchain.
lines.say: A wallet holds keys, which prove you control your crypto. The coins themselves are entries on the blockchain.

lines.text: On an exchange, the exchange holds the keys for you. Lose your keys, and you can lose access.
lines.say: On an exchange, the exchange holds the keys for you. Lose your keys, and you can lose access.

lines.text: Two words you'll hear: coins and tokens. A coin runs on its own blockchain.
lines.say: Two words you'll hear: coins and tokens. A coin runs on its own blockchain.

lines.text: A token is built on top of an existing one. USDT is a token designed to track the US dollar.
lines.say: A token is built on top of an existing one. U S D T is a token designed to track the US dollar.

lines.text: Now a worked example. What is my BTC worth?
lines.say: Now a worked example. What is my B-T-C worth?

lines.text: Say you hold 0.002 BTC, and one BTC costs 60,000 USDT.
lines.say: Say you hold zero point zero zero two B T C, and one B T C costs sixty thousand U S D T.

lines.text: Amount times price: 120 USDT. That's all it is.
lines.say: Amount times price: one hundred and twenty U S D T. That's all it is.

lines.text: Now watch what happens when the price moves.
lines.say: Now watch what happens when the price moves.

lines.text: The price rises to 63,000. Your value rises to 126.
lines.say: The price rises to sixty-three thousand. Your value rises to one hundred and twenty-six.

lines.text: Then it falls to 57,000. Your value falls to 114.
lines.say: Then it falls to fifty-seven thousand. Your value falls to one hundred and fourteen.

lines.text: Notice: you still hold the same 0.002 BTC. Only its value changed.
lines.say: Notice: you still hold the same zero point zero zero two B T C. Only its value changed.

lines.text: Your turn. You hold 0.002 BTC, and the price is 65,000 USDT. What is it worth? Pause if you need more time.
lines.say: Your turn. You hold zero point zero zero two B T C, and the price is sixty-five thousand U S D T. What is it worth? Pause if you need more time.

lines.text: The answer: 130 USDT. Well done if you got it.
lines.say: The answer: one hundred and thirty U S D T. Well done if you got it.

lines.text: Quick check: crypto, or not crypto?
lines.say: Quick check: crypto, or not crypto?

lines.text: Bitcoin: crypto. Game points: not crypto. Ether: crypto. A bank balance: not crypto.
lines.say: Bitcoin: crypto. Game points: not crypto. Ether: crypto. A bank balance: not crypto.

lines.text: And USDT? It counts too. It's a crypto token.
lines.say: And U S D T? It counts too. It's a crypto token.

lines.text: Before you go further, know the risks.
lines.say: Before you go further, know the risks.

lines.text: No government stands behind crypto. If something goes wrong, nobody has to pay you back.
lines.say: No government stands behind crypto. If something goes wrong, nobody has to pay you back.

lines.text: Prices can rise or fall a lot in a single day.
lines.say: Prices can rise or fall a lot in a single day.

lines.text: Lose your keys, or get tricked by a scammer, and your crypto can be gone for good.
lines.say: Lose your keys, or get tricked by a scammer, and your crypto can be gone for good.

lines.text: And owning BTC is not the same as trading futures, which are contracts about its price. We'll cover those later.
lines.say: And owning B-T-C is not the same as trading futures, which are contracts about its price. We'll cover those later.

lines.text: Learn first, and never risk money you can't afford to lose.
lines.say: Learn first, and never risk money you can't afford to lose.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Cryptocurrency is a digital asset recorded on a shared blockchain.
lines.say: Cryptocurrency is a digital asset recorded on a shared blockchain.

lines.text: A wallet holds keys. The coins live on the blockchain.
lines.say: A wallet holds keys. The coins live on the blockchain.

lines.text: And value equals amount times price. The amount stays; the value moves.
lines.say: And value equals amount times price. The amount stays; the value moves.

lines.text: Check yourself: if BTC falls ten percent, what happens to your 0.002 BTC?
lines.say: Check yourself: if B T C falls ten percent, what happens to your zero point zero zero two B T C?

lines.text: You still hold 0.002 BTC. Its value falls by ten percent.
lines.say: You still hold zero point zero zero two B T C. Its value falls by ten percent.

lines.text: Great start! Next up: why do crypto prices move? See you in lesson two.
lines.say: Great start! Next up: why do crypto prices move? See you in lesson two.
